Re: Introduction: Antigone Davis (Meta) »> Mattito Watson (USAID)
[contact omitted] Matthew Watson Wednesday, December 21, 2022 at 1:57:14 PM Eastern Standard Time
10: [contact omitted] Sean Litton
Cc: [contact omitted] Antigone Davis, [contact omitted] Anna Clift
Hi Sean
Thank you for the introduction!
Antigone-l'd love to schedule a call in the first two weeks of January-can you send me a few possible meetings times that work for you and let's get something on the books.
Mattito
On Mon, Dec 19, 2022 at 12:25 PM Sean Litton • [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Mattito,
would like to introduce you to Antigone Davis who serves as the VP, Global Head of Safety at Meta. Antigone has let me know that she and her team would be happy i
peak with you about what USAID is planning around public-private partnerships in the Child Safety space
Antigone, thank you for your time and input.
Thanks,
Sean
